title: Representation of the People Fifth Amendment Ordinance 2002

sections.shortTitle: Representation of the People Fifth Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

REPRESENTATION OF THE PEOPLE
REPRESENTATION OF
THE PEOPLE
(FIFTH AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE CXXXII OF
2002
An Ordinance further to amend the Representation of the People Act. 1976
[Gazette of Pakistan. Extraordinary. Part I, 21st
November, 2002)
F.No. 2(1)/2002-Pub., dated
21-11-2002.----- The following Ordinance. promulgated by the President on
15th November, 2002 is hereby published for general information:-
1. Short title and
commencement. ---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Representation of the
People (Fifth Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the twenty-first day of
August, 2002.
